comment: Param index 10 (RELEASEATNV_PARAM) is declared at SickoSampler2.cpp:55 but never given a widget, so it cannot be clicked and gets no line; there are no attenuverters on this version at all. There is also no tuning knob, no limiter switch and no separate record fade knob — the XFD knob covers the record fade as well. The Trig Type switch has two positions here where sickoSampler and sickoPlayer have three. The monitor is a lit button rather than a three-position switch. The waveform display is a custom widget with no ParamWidget, so the Copy Cue to Loop and Copy Loop to Cue items on its own menu cannot be reached by clicking it for help; Reset Cursors and the save commands also appear on the module's own menu.
